shell_commands_agents: Command palette and shortcut list entry that switches the main view to the list of agents, or back to the worktree.
shell_commands_changes: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens the tab with the worktree's git changes.
shell_commands_check_for_updates: Command palette and shortcut list entry that asks whether a new version exists.
shell_commands_close_all_editors: Command palette and shortcut list entry that closes every file editor tab of the worktree.
shell_commands_close_all_tabs: Command palette and shortcut list entry that closes every tab of the focused pane.
shell_commands_close_other_tabs: Command palette and shortcut list entry that closes every tab of the pane except the active one.
shell_commands_close_tab: Command palette and shortcut list entry that closes the active tab; also the confirm button when the tab still runs a program.
shell_commands_closing_ends_it: Body of the confirmation when closing a terminal tab whose foreground program is running.
shell_commands_command_palette: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens the command palette.
shell_commands_copy_service_url: Palette entry that copies the URL of a service of the project. {name} is the service name from atlas.yaml.
shell_commands_create_worktree: Palette entry that creates a worktree named as typed. {name} is the typed text.
shell_commands_crew: Command palette and shortcut list entry that switches between the IDE and the Atlas Crew workspace. The product name is not translated.
shell_commands_crew_replay_onboarding: Command palette and shortcut list entry that restarts the Atlas Crew introduction.
shell_commands_crew_toggle_board: Command palette and shortcut list entry that switches the Crew workspace between the chat and the board of tasks.
shell_commands_dashboard: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens the dashboard view.
shell_commands_generate_commit_message: Command palette and shortcut list entry that asks the configured provider to write a commit message for the staged changes.
shell_commands_go_back: Command palette and shortcut list entry that returns to the previous place in the visit history.
shell_commands_go_forward: Command palette and shortcut list entry that goes to the next place in the visit history.
shell_commands_go_to_file: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens the file finder. The ellipsis marks that it asks for input.
shell_commands_go_to_last_tab: Command palette and shortcut list entry that activates the last tab (the last crewmate in the Crew workspace).
shell_commands_go_to_space: Command palette and shortcut list entry that jumps to the n-th project space of the title bar. Hidden from the palette; listed in the shortcut settings. {n} is 1 to 9.
shell_commands_go_to_symbol: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens the symbol outline of the focused editor. The ellipsis marks that it asks for input.
shell_commands_go_to_tab: Command palette and shortcut list entry that activates the n-th tab (the n-th crewmate in the Crew workspace). Hidden from the palette; listed in the shortcut settings. {n} is 1 to 8.
shell_commands_group_commands: Group heading of the command palette for the commands that were not used recently.
shell_commands_group_create: Group heading of the palette for the entry that creates a worktree with the typed name.
shell_commands_group_files: Group heading of the go-to-file palette.
shell_commands_group_project: Group heading of the command palette for the current project's services and actions.
shell_commands_group_recent_chats: Group heading of the jump palette for the chats and terminals used last.
shell_commands_group_recent_commands: Group heading of the command palette for the commands used last.
shell_commands_group_recent_worktrees: Group heading of the jump palette for the worktrees used last.
shell_commands_group_symbols: Group heading of the go-to-symbol palette.
shell_commands_jump: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens the jump palette (worktrees, recent terminals).
shell_commands_keyboard_shortcuts: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens the Settings section with the keyboard shortcuts.
shell_commands_new_agent_session: Command palette and shortcut list entry that starts the default coding agent in a new tab.
shell_commands_new_browser_tab: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens a browser tab.
shell_commands_new_omp_chat: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens a chat with omp, the built-in coding agent.
shell_commands_new_terminal: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens a terminal tab.
shell_commands_new_worktree: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens the dialog that creates a worktree. The ellipsis marks the dialog.
shell_commands_next_space: Command palette and shortcut list entry that switches to the next project space.
shell_commands_next_tab: Command palette and shortcut list entry that activates the next tab of the pane.
shell_commands_nothing_to_save: Command palette and shortcut list entry that is not a command: the toast shown when Save or Save all finds no modified editor.
shell_commands_open_html_preview: Command palette and shortcut list entry that previews the HTML file of the active editor.
shell_commands_open_service: Palette entry that opens a service of the project in the browser. {name} is the service name from atlas.yaml.
shell_commands_panel: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens or reveals the project Panel tab (services and stack).
shell_commands_panel_stays_open: Toast when someone closes the project Panel tab, which is pinned and cannot be closed.
shell_commands_previous_space: Command palette and shortcut list entry that switches to the previous project space.
shell_commands_previous_tab: Command palette and shortcut list entry that activates the previous tab of the pane.
shell_commands_project_menu_change_icon: Item of the menu of a project dot (right-click): opens the icon and color editor.
shell_commands_project_menu_pin: Item of the menu of a project dot (right-click): pins the project at the top of the list.
shell_commands_project_menu_remove: Destructive item of the menu of a project dot (right-click): removes the project from the list; the folder stays on disk.
shell_commands_project_menu_unpin: Item of the menu of a project dot (right-click): removes the pin.
shell_commands_quit: Command palette and shortcut list entry that quits the app. Listed off macOS only, where the app menu has it.
shell_commands_recent_worktree: Command palette and shortcut list entry that jumps to the n-th most recent worktree. Hidden from the palette; listed in the shortcut settings. {n} is 1 to 6.
shell_commands_reload_terminal: Command palette and shortcut list entry that reloads the native view of the active terminal.
shell_commands_reopen_closed_tab: Command palette and shortcut list entry that reopens the tab closed last.
shell_commands_restart_service: Command palette and shortcut list entry that restarts the service selected in the Panel.
shell_commands_save_all: Command palette and shortcut list entry that saves every modified editor.
shell_commands_search_in_project: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens the search panel and focuses its field.
shell_commands_settings: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens Settings.
shell_commands_shell_environment: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens the Settings section that shows the shell environment.
shell_commands_show_activity: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens the activity view of the project.
shell_commands_show_machine: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens the machine view with its load and the running agents.
shell_commands_split_down: Command palette and shortcut list entry that splits the pane and puts the active tab below.
shell_commands_split_right: Command palette and shortcut list entry that splits the pane and puts the active tab on the right.
shell_commands_start_stack: Command palette and shortcut list entry that starts every service of the project.
shell_commands_still_running: Title of the confirmation when closing a terminal tab whose foreground program is running. {name} is the program's name.
shell_commands_stop_stack: Command palette and shortcut list entry that stops every service of the project.
shell_commands_switch_branch: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens the branch picker. The ellipsis marks that it asks for input.
shell_commands_switch_to_older_tab: Command palette and shortcut list entry that switches to the tab used before the previous one.
shell_commands_switch_to_recent_tab: Command palette and shortcut list entry that switches to the tab used just before this one.
shell_commands_symbol_in: Kind of a symbol that sits inside another, in the go-to-symbol palette. {kind} and {container} are names from the language server, shown as is.
shell_commands_symbol_line: Description of a symbol in the go-to-symbol palette. {kind} is the symbol kind as the language server or the syntax tree names it (function, class), shown as is; {line} is a line number.
shell_commands_terminal_theme_named: Command palette and shortcut list entry that selects a theme for the terminal only. {name} is the theme's own name, shown as is.
shell_commands_terminal_theme_same_as_ap: Command palette and shortcut list entry that makes the terminal use the app's theme.
shell_commands_theme_import: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens Settings at Appearance to import a theme. The ellipsis marks that it asks for input.
shell_commands_theme_named: Command palette and shortcut list entry that selects a theme. {name} is the theme's own name, shown as is.
shell_commands_theme_next: Command palette and shortcut list entry that selects the next theme.
shell_commands_theme_previous: Command palette and shortcut list entry that selects the previous theme.
shell_commands_theme_use_ghostty: Command palette and shortcut list entry that opens Settings at Appearance, where the detected Ghostty theme is applied. Ghostty is a product name.
shell_commands_theme_used_in_dark: Toast after selecting a dark theme while the app shows a light one: the theme applies when the app is in dark mode.
shell_commands_theme_used_in_light: Toast after selecting a light theme while the app shows a dark one: the theme applies when the app is in light mode.
shell_commands_toggle_all_docks: Command palette and shortcut list entry that shows or hides every dock at once.
shell_commands_toggle_bottom_dock: Command palette and shortcut list entry that shows or hides the bottom dock (terminal panel).
shell_commands_toggle_centered_layout: Command palette and shortcut list entry that centers the workbench with margins on both sides.
shell_commands_toggle_fullscreen: Command palette and shortcut list entry that enters or leaves full screen. Listed off macOS only.
shell_commands_toggle_git_panel: Command palette and shortcut list entry that shows or focuses the source control panel.
shell_commands_toggle_left_dock: Command palette and shortcut list entry that shows or hides the left dock (sidebar with files and git).
shell_commands_toggle_pane_zoom: Command palette and shortcut list entry that zooms the focused pane to fill the window, or restores it.
shell_commands_toggle_project_panel: Command palette and shortcut list entry that shows or focuses the file explorer panel.
shell_commands_toggle_right_sidebar: Command palette and shortcut list entry that pins or hides the right sidebar.
shell_commands_toggle_sidebar: Command palette and shortcut list entry that shows or hides the left sidebar.
shell_commands_toggle_terminal_panel: Command palette and shortcut list entry that shows, focuses or hides the terminal panel at the bottom.
shell_commands_update_to: Command palette and shortcut list entry that takes the person to the release notes of the version that is ready. {version} is a version number such as 1.5.0.
shell_commands_whats_new: Command palette and shortcut list entry that shows the release notes.
shell_commands_zoom_in: Command palette and shortcut list entry that makes the interface bigger.
shell_commands_zoom_out: Command palette and shortcut list entry that makes the interface smaller.
shell_commands_zoom_reset: Command palette and shortcut list entry that returns the interface to its default size.
